name: Unbroken
condition: Clear a room while Bloodied without being healed in it
effect: While Bloodied, your Rage damage bonus doubles.

name: Charm the Pants Off
condition: A fight ends with an enemy charmed, frightened or talked into surrender
effect: Once per room, a creature that fails a save against your charm spell fights for you until the end of its next turn.

name: Divine Witness
condition: Restore an ally from 0 HP and deal radiant damage in the same turn
effect: Channel Divinity regains one use after each boss.

name: Many Faces
condition: Drop an enemy in Wild Shape and another with a spell in the same room
effect: You can cast cantrips while in Wild Shape.

name: Perfect Form
condition: Hit with every attack you make in a room (at least 6 attacks)
effect: Action Surge regains one use after each boss.

name: Empty Hand
condition: Clear a room using only unarmed strikes
effect: Flurry of Blows makes one extra strike.

name: Oathkeeper
condition: Heal an ally and Divine Smite in the same turn
effect: Once per room, Divine Smite costs no spell slot.

name: Pog's Path
condition: Hit your Hunter's Mark target with every attack you make in a room
effect: You ignore difficult terrain, and room tricks never reveal your position.

name: Unseen Hand
condition: Drop an enemy that never saw you
effect: Your Sneak Attack dice become d8s.

name: Wild Overflow
condition: Spend every Sorcery Point you have in a single room
effect: Regain half your Sorcery Points at the end of each room.

name: Pact Echo
condition: Hit with every Eldritch Blast beam in a turn of 3 or more beams
effect: Your Pact Magic slots refresh after each boss.

name: The Archivist
condition: Keep three different spell effects active on enemies at once
effect: Once per floor, cast a spell of 5th level or lower from your spellbook without spending a slot.

name: Lost and Found
effect: Once per run, recover one consumable you used up this run.

name: Thils's Wink
effect: Once per room, reroll a d20 test made against a room trick.

name: Pilgrim's Due
effect: Gain 1 extra Devotion when you extract.

name: Keeper of Ways
effect: You always see a room's true exit.

name: Collector's Eye
effect: Your share of run loot increases by 10%.

name: Trapwise
effect: Room tricks you trigger deal half damage to you.

name: Maze Runner
effect: +10 ft speed in rooms with more than one exit.

name: Offering Accepted
effect: Once per floor, when you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead.
